In addition to my IVs and visits with Dr. Porter, I also recently became acquainted with Dr. Julie Kieffer, a Nathuropath who is now performing minor surgical procedures in the office. More than 20 years ago, when I was a teenager, I had an accident that tore my earlobe all the way through. I had always wanted to fix it, but never made it a priority. Instead, I just repierced my ear (and tried to cover the tear with my hair). I was thrilled to learn that Dr. Kieffer was able to fix my earlobe in a simple, cost-effective, in-office procedure.
Although I was somewhat nervous before the procedure, Dr. Kieffer immediately put me at ease. I was in great, experienced hands and I literally felt no discomfort (not even when injected with the local anesthesia). In less than one hour, my ear was made whole again. I was expertly stitched up and sent on my merry way. I felt little or no pain later that day or the days following. The stitches were removed a week later – and now three weeks post-procedure, my earlobe is looking great! The scarring is already fading significantly, and I’ll be repiercing in the next couple months.
I would highly recommend Dr. Kieffer for minor surgical procedures and look forward to seeing her again during her ‘Whack-a-Mole’ clinics. She is kind, gentle and, above all, well-skilled. And her rates are terrific, too.  Chalk this up to another terrific experience at EVND!
